label: ascension picture: fighter fields
why: The picture's own state on the fighter (fade, ages, the tallies as last seen, the threads); written by tickAscend only, read by the draws only.

label: ascension picture: the presentation call
why: tickAscend runs on the presentation clock, which runs through hit stops and after the match; so the picture plays through the freeze and closes itself at `over`.

label: ascension picture: tickAscend
why: Drives the window's picture off ultRise && !over && alive (Canopy's rule), finds each shaft blow by `hits` rising while lit and each heal by riseTally.bless rising; writes presentation fields, tags and taught only.

label: ascension picture: the world call (under both balls)
why: World pass under both balls: the rise column, the halo, the foot pools (bloom share 0).

label: ascension picture: the emissive call (over both fighters)
why: The shafts' 3-unit cores under `lighter` (v74: 'under lighter ONLY the core'), both shells cut out.

label: ascension picture: the shafts' hook in drawWeapon
anchor: if ((f.treeFade > 0 || f.ultTree) && this.drawTreeWeapon(m, f, reach, dim)) return;
code:
/* ASCENSION'S SHAFTS (v74 section 6.1): while the shafts are lit and
       while they shorten, the blades are drawn at their REST length and the
       light runs on from them to the edge of the live hall
       (`drawAscendWeapon`) -- `reachMul` is 10 and would draw the blade art
       ~680 units long, past every wall, and it stays 10 through the verdict
       when the match ends in the window. `ascendFade` is 0 and `ultRise` null
       on every other relic, so this is two comparisons on fields nothing
       else writes. */
    if ((f.ascendFade > 0 || f.ultRise) && this.drawAscendWeapon(m, f, dim)) return;
why: While lit, closing, or through a verdict that left the window open, the blades are drawn at rest and the light runs on to the live hall's edge; reachMul 10 would draw the blade art ~680 units long past every wall.

label: ascension picture: the body trail's ghost
code:
/* ASCENSION (v74 section 6.1): the body trail is fed by `move`, which a
       pinned ball skips, and `tickRise` carries the ball away from it -- so
       for the whole window the trail sat where the cast was, a ghost of the
       ball on the floor it left. Not drawn while the picture is up; `move`
       refills it within 0.15s of the release, inside the close.
       `ascendFade` is 0 on every other relic. */
    const tr = f.ascendFade > 0 ? [] : f.trail;
why: drawFighter's body trail is fed by move(), which a pinned ball skips; tickRise carries the ball away, so the stale trail drew a ghost ball at the cast point for the whole window. Hidden while ascendFade > 0 (0 on every other relic).

label: ascension picture: the drawing methods
why: drawAscend (column, halo, pools), _ascendEdge/_ascendLen (the live hall's edge), drawAscendWeapon (bodies, motes, the blades at rest), drawAscendTop (cores, then the threads over them).
